anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: T701 reads 431.291 °C while adjacent T702 reads 96.834 °C, a large temperature discrepancy requiring verification.
The discrepancy persists: T701 is 434.359 °C and T702 is 107.900 °C; these data cannot distinguish a real thermal anomaly from a sensor fault.
T711 rises from 72.324 to 82.755 °C in one interval while T712 falls from 66.800 to 65.212 °C; reflux and distillate flows rise from 0.209/0.414 to 0.294/0.619 L/h.
Measured reflux/distillate flow ratio is approximately 0.461, whereas FYI702 reads 4.558; interpretation requires confirmation of the ratio tag's definition.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol operating limits and setpoints; independent verification of T701 and its calibration/tag mapping; FYI702 definition; composition measurements and separation target. Pressure diagnostics are unavailable because pressure instruments are not installed.
